purpose: Treat the first item as obvious and add a wider one.
keywords: Local residents as well as students may use it.
The food tastes good, of course, and its presentation is beautiful too.
Orders come from overseas as well as from within the country.
restrictions: Often paired with も in the second phrase.
mistake: The first item is included, not excluded or set aside.

segments.role: Treat the first item as obvious and add a wider one. N + はもとより

examples.translation: Local residents as well as students may use it.
examples.note: Broadens access beyond the obvious group.
